context:
Evaluating a Coralogix support response for this user question:

Kubernetes auto-instrumentation injected our pods and traces are arriving, but APM service discovery is empty or shows unknown_service. Which resource attribute is probably missing, and how should it be supplied?

checklist.name: identifies-missing-resource-scope-service-nam
checklist.description: Identifies missing resource-scope service.name as the likely issue and recommends setting OTEL_SERVICE_NAME or equivalent resource attributes during auto-injection. FAIL if it recommends adding service.name only as a span attribute.
